ticket.subject: Duplicate day in the weekly chart
ticket.body_text:
Hi team,

The raw numbers in the table below the chart are correct. I see it in both Chrome and Firefox.

No rush on this, whenever you have a moment. Could you take a look?

Regards,
Chloe
